en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a richly decorated neo‑Renaissance corner building labeled "Börse," with arched windows, sculptural reliefs, and crowds of people and horse‑drawn vehicles gathered around the entrance. It is set in a dense European street with multi‑story buildings; shop signs in Latin and Cyrillic letters are visible on the left and right façades.
